q6_depth1:
SELECT sum(x.l_extendedprice * x.l_discount) AS revenue, count(*) AS cnt
FROM orders_depth1
LATERAL VIEW explode(c) lv0 AS x
WHERE x.l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND x.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND x.l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.07 AND x.l_quantity < 24

e13_join_coalesce: SELECT coalesce(c.c_mktsegment, 'NONE') AS seg, count(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
e13_nested: SELECT coalesce(c.c_mktsegment, 'NONE') AS seg, count(*) AS n_orders FROM orders_nested o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
e14_case_join: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN p.p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS promo_rev, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_rev FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
e14_nested: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN p.p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS promo_rev, sum(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_rev FROM (SELECT explode(lineitems) AS li FROM orders_nested) t JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
e19_inlist: SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS rev FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_quantity IN (5, 6, 7, 8) AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') AND l.l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.08
e19_nested_array: SELECT sum(size(filter(lineitems, x -> x.l_quantity IN (5,6,7,8) AND x.l_shipmode IN ('AIR','RAIL') AND x.l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.08))) AS n, sum(aggregate(filter(lineitems, x -> x.l_quantity IN (5,6,7,8) AND x.l_shipmode IN ('AIR','RAIL') AND x.l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.08), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,4)), (acc, x) -> acc + CAST(x.l_extendedprice * (1 - x.l_discount) AS DECIMAL(38,4)))) AS rev FROM orders_nested
e07_string_join: SELECT upper(substring(p.p_brand, 1, 5)) AS b, count(*) AS n FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipmode = 'TRUCK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
e07_nested: SELECT upper(substring(p.p_brand, 1, 5)) AS b, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT explode(lineitems) AS li FROM orders_nested) t JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE li.l_shipmode = 'TRUCK' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
e21_quantifiers: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l2 WHERE l2.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey AND l2.l_shipdate > l2.l_commitdate)
e21_nested: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM orders_nested WHERE o_orderstatus = 'F' AND size(filter(lineitems, x -> x.l_receiptdate > x.l_commitdate)) > 0 AND size(filter(lineitems, x -> x.l_shipdate > x.l_commitdate)) = 0
e18_topn_window: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT l_orderkey FROM (SELECT l_orderkey, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l_orderkey ORDER BY l_extendedprice DESC) AS rn, l_extendedprice FROM lineitem) t WHERE rn <= 2 AND l_extendedprice > 30000 GROUP BY l_orderkey)
e18_nested: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT reverse(array_sort(transform(lineitems, x -> x.l_extendedprice))) AS tops FROM orders_nested) t WHERE size(slice(tops, 1, 2)) > 0 AND size(filter(slice(tops, 1, 2), e -> e > 30000)) > 0
